promise.title: The Svarna Promise
promise.purity_desc: Every piece carries a Bureau of Indian Standards hallmark — guaranteed 22K purity you can trust.
promise.rates_desc: Gold and silver prices update in real time from international bullion markets — no hidden markups.
promise.bespoke_desc: Work directly with our karigar team to design custom jewellery for weddings, anniversaries, or gifting.

heritage.para1: Indian jewellery is one of the oldest art forms on earth — worn by royalty, offered at temples, and passed down through generations as heirlooms of love. At Svarna, we honour that tradition with every piece that leaves our workshop.
heritage.para2: Each ornament is crafted by master karigars trained in techniques that trace their roots to Mughal and Rajput ateliers. From meenakari enamel to kundan stone-setting and jadau inlay — we make jewellery that carries a story.
